blocks.text: Ford Van Wrap for Gurm’s Garage

blocks.alt: Gurm's Garage Ford Van Wrap. From passenger side view.

blocks.html:
We installed a Ford van wrap for Gurm’s Garage. We included their services and specialties, Gurm’s Garage logo, phone number, website on brand colors red, white and white.

Gurm’s Garage Ford Van Wrap before and after. Taken outside of Vinyl Wrap Toronto garage before and after installation.

Thanks to Branding Centres for the professional graphic design and setup on this Ford Van.

3M 1080 Series IJ 180 Printable Vinyl with Gloss Finish was used for the design of this project. Check out Wrap Authority for vehicle design templates.

For more partial van wraps, check out our partial van wraps page.

For van wraps in general, check out our van wraps page.

This is a commercial vehicle wrap, if you have a business you might be interested in more commercial wraps category.
